critical_code_review_comments: server.py router registration order matters: when two routers share a prefix (/returns and /returns/partner), the more-specific sub-router MUST be included first — otherwise FastAPI matches /returns/partner against /returns/{return_id} with the wrong auth dependency. rca of the issue: GET /api/returns/partner was returning 401 for valid food-partner JWTs. Root cause: server.py included customer_router (prefix /returns, containing GET /{return_id}) BEFORE partner_router (prefix /returns/partner). FastAPI matches routes in order, so /returns/partner hit customer_router.get_return(return_id='partner') which uses get_current_customer dependency → 401 for the food-partner bearer. Reproduction: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <food_partner_jwt>' $URL/api/returns/partner. Mitigation (applied): swap include_router order so partner_router is registered first. Verified fix with pytest (17/17 pass incl. test_partner_lists_and_approves_pending_return).
